reasoning: Round 1 bought nothing: all replays, every run a sphere, no forcing mechanism run. Frontier is to FORCE a protrusion, not re-measure spheres. Breed from parent 1 (growth+coupling = Okuda's mechanism): flagship = monolayer shape-energy (Okuda cell sheet) and chemistry-gated growth. Ablate growth/division/feedback for the necessity map. Anchor with parent-0 mechanics-only control (no growth, guaranteed admissible, no saturation).

slots.claim: parent mechanics-only, no growth, stays a sphere -- the admissible anchor
slots.why: control; no growth so cannot saturate the buffer -- a guaranteed-admissible baseline

slots.claim: growth on a MONOLAYER cell sheet (Okuda's geometry) deforms into undulation, not a sphere
slots.revisits: every composition tested is a sphere (round 1)
slots.confounder: shape-energy implementation: monolayer sheet mechanics vs bulk energy
slots.why: Okuda's substrate is a 2000-cell monolayer vesicle; bulk energy in round 1 may be why nothing buckled -- the undulation route

slots.claim: gating growth by the Turing pattern converts surface chemistry into localized deformation
slots.confounder: coupling of chemistry to growth via the gate connection (uncoupled -> coupled)
slots.why: Okuda's key claim is that coupling patterning to deformation drives tubulation; this edit makes the coupling

slots.claim: curvature-sensed mechano-chemical feedback sharpens growth into a protrusion
slots.why: curvature feedback is the canonical instability that turns a bulge into a tube

slots.claim: tension-sensed feedback also forces deformation, distinguishing the sensor channel
slots.why: compare sensor channels (tension vs curvature vs pressure) at one growth setting

slots.claim: pressure-sensed feedback gives an equilibrium bulge, weaker than curvature
slots.why: pressure sensing should equilibrate (mech_p_ratio ~1) rather than force; maps the third channel

slots.claim: without morphogen growth the tissue cannot deform -- growth is necessary for any protrusion
slots.why: Okuda's uncoupled/arrested cases; ablation tests necessity of growth AND is no-growth so cannot saturate

slots.claim: growth without cell division still forces a protrusion -- division is NOT necessary
slots.why: removing division also relieves buffer pressure; tests whether the bud needs proliferation or just volume

slots.claim: removing mechano-chemical feedback abolishes tube formation -- feedback is necessary for a tube
slots.why: isolates whether patterned growth alone suffices or the shape->chem loop is required for a sustained tube

slots.claim: Gierer-Meinhardt kinetics give sharper spots and a more localized protrusion than default
slots.why: swaps the Turing kernel to test whether pattern sharpness controls protrusion amplitude

slots.claim: Brusselator kinetics pattern differently but still couple to growth
slots.why: second kinetics variant to separate pattern-type from deformation outcome

slots.claim: a single localized spot seed grows into ONE thin tube
slots.why: localized seeding is how a single tubulation site is set; targets Okuda's thin-tube morphology

slots.claim: cone/tip-localized seeding concentrates growth at a pole and elongates a protrusion
slots.why: tip-localization is the geometry for elongation; complements the spot route toward a tube

slots.claim: non-conserved Hill growth over-inflates: high protrusion but risks buffer saturation
slots.why: extreme growth reveals the forcing ceiling a moderate operating point hides; if it saturates that itself bounds the reservoir

slots.claim: cell division alone, without morphogen growth, does not force a tube (stays near-sphere)
slots.why: isolates division from patterned growth on the no-growth parent; a clean map cell for proliferation-only

slots.claim: uniform inflation without patterning stays a sphere -- deformation needs patterned, not bulk, growth
slots.why: negative-control excursion: proves the protrusion in the growth slots comes from PATTERNING, not volume alone
